_about: Rooms with centred connectors. Three sizes, in tiles: small (1x1), medium (1x2) and large (2x2).
Small: D (dead end, one opening, north; never used), I (straight), L (corner), T (east, south and west) and X (all four sides).
Medium: I, L (north + east on the bottom tile), J (mirror of L), S (east on the top tile, west on the bottom) and Z (mirror of S).
Large: L (north on the top-left tile, east on the bottom-right), S (east on the top-right tile, west on the bottom-left) and Z (west on the top-left, east on the bottom-right).
Each room is one shape; its 'images' are art variations, spread evenly over the rooms placed.
No 'copies', so each room can be used any number of times. Linear maps (--linear) use the two-opening rooms.
name: Temple
